name: decrement_counter_set_status

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:devs/ramdrive.device:0:05E8
name: store_value_into_field

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:devs/ramdrive.device:0:05F0

It stores the handler's result byte back into the request and, when a flag bit is clear, makes a further call before a final cleanup call.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:devs/ramdrive.device:0:062C
name: return_constant_minus_three

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:devs/ramdrive.device:0:0718
name: expire_and_unlink_timed_node
description: Decrements a countdown field in a node and, once it goes negative for a node still on a list, unlinks the node from that list. It then removes the node from a second list, calls a library function, and appends a colon to a string held in the node.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:devs/ramdrive.device:0:077C
name: unlink_entry_and_append_colon

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:devs/ramdrive.device:0:0790
name: terminate_string_with_colon
description: Copies a value through a pointer and stores a value returned by a function pointer into a structure field. It then walks a string to its null terminator, replaces that terminator with a colon, and finishes with a call through the global base.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:dcs:0:0000
name: load_amigados_hunk_file

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:dcs:0:017C
name: busy_wait_countdown
description: Counts a 16-bit register down in a loop until it passes zero, so it burns time without touching any other state. It returns nothing.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:dcs:0:01CC
name: unpack_bytes_backward
description: Decodes a bit-packed stream of codes that either emit literal bytes or copy runs of earlier output, filling a buffer from its end toward its start. It stops when the start of the buffer is reached.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:dcs:0:0218
name: shift_bits_through_buffer
description: Shifts a counted number of bits through a multi-word bit buffer, pulling a new input word whenever the buffer runs empty. The bits are built up in a shift register that is returned to the caller.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:dcs:0:026C
name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: The decoded code is a trap followed by bad instruction data, so it is not a real routine. It is only a fragment of misdecoded bytes.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:Install F117A:0:0000
name: run_installer_main
description: Program entry for the installer. It clears a block of global storage, opens the DOS library and the resources it needs, and then either builds a quoted command string from its argument or runs the default path and reports a fixed error code.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:Install F117A:0:017C
name: release_installer_resources
description: Stores a result, runs an optional cleanup pointer, and then, depending on two stored fields, closes the open files and libraries and frees the memory the installer holds. It finishes with a final cleanup call.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:Install F117A:0:01F8
name: call_indirect_function
description: Calls a function whose address is read from a fixed negative offset relative to a pointer on the stack, then returns. The routine passes no arguments of its own.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:Install F117A:0:022C
name: return_without_work
description: The body is only a return, so calling it has no effect. Its address is taken elsewhere, so it is used as a callback that does nothing.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:Install F117A:0:022E
name: return_without_work
description: The body is only a return, so calling it has no effect. Its address is taken elsewhere, so it is used as a callback that does nothing.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:Install F117A:0:0230
name: forward_after_optional_seek
description: Looks up an entry from a handle and returns minus one if the entry is missing. When a particular flag bit is set it first moves to the end of the stream, then forwards the call with the entry's pointer and returns minus one if a status field is set.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:Install F117A:0:0298
name: emit_string_buffer_or_callback
description: Walks a zero-terminated string and writes each character into a memory buffer while room remains, or through a callback routine once the room runs out. It finishes by sending a sentinel to the callback and returns the string length.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:Install F117A:0:0300
name: format_printf_directive
description: Parses one printf-style conversion specifier, including its flags, width, precision and size modifier. It fetches the next argument and formats it as a character, string, signed or unsigned decimal number, or hexadecimal value, pads it to the requested width, and sends the characters through a callback. It returns zero for an unknown conversion letter.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:Install F117A:0:06FE
name: format_string_via_callback
description: Walks a format string and sends each plain character to a callback. A doubled percent sign is sent as a literal percent sign, and a single one is handed to the conversion routine, which consumes the directive and its argument; if the conversion fails, the percent sign itself is sent.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:Install F117A:0:0758
name: tokenize_args_open_console
description: Splits the command line into tokens, honouring quoted strings and star-prefixed escape codes, and records the token pointers. It then opens the console window and standard streams, falling back to a default console specification when the command line is empty.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:Install F117A:0:09CC
name: run_installer_dialogue_sequence
description: Runs the installer's interactive dialogue when a stack buffer check passes: it prints a series of prompts, reads responses in a loop until one is accepted, and returns the final result. Otherwise it reads one character from a buffer and returns it in upper case.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:Install F117A:0:09EC
name: open_record_stream_if_needed
description: Opens a stream for a record when its handle field is empty or a flag bit requests it, storing the new handle and clearing the position fields. On failure it records error code twelve and returns minus one; otherwise it returns zero.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:Install F117A:0:0A48
name: write_char_buffered_crlf
description: Writes one character into a buffered stream record, sending a line feed as a carriage return and line feed pair when the record is in text mode. When the buffer fills it passes the buffered bytes on through a write call, and it records any write error in the status flags. It returns the character written, or a failure value.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:Install F117A:0:0CD8
name: call_active_entries_reverse
description: Walks a table of eight-byte entries from the last to the first. For each entry that is marked active and lacks a particular flag bit, it calls a routine with that entry's stored value, then makes a final call with its own argument.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:Install F117A:0:0D34
name: read_and_uppercase_first_char
description: Stores a text pointer and a length into a record, calls a routine to read into it, and returns the first byte read converted to upper case when it is a lowercase letter.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:Install F117A:0:0D50
name: convert_char_to_uppercase
description: Returns its argument unchanged unless it is a lowercase letter, in which case it returns the matching upper-case letter by subtracting a fixed offset.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:Install F117A:0:0D68
name: uppercase_string_in_place
description: Converts each character of a zero-terminated string to upper case in place, using a per-character class table to decide which characters are lowercase letters. It returns the string pointer.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:Install F117A:0:0DAC
name: split_path_into_components
description: Splits a file path into its device, directory, file name and extension parts by scanning it for a device separator, slashes and a dot. It clears each caller buffer first and then writes the matching part into it.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:Install F117A:0:0F00
name: copy_bounded_string_zero_pad
description: Copies a zero-terminated string into a destination of fixed size, stopping after the given count. If the source ends before the count is used up, the rest of the destination is filled with zero bytes, and the destination pointer is returned.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:Install F117A:0:0F24
name: compare_strings_limited
description: Compares two zero-terminated strings for at most a given number of bytes. It returns the difference of the first unequal bytes, returns one or minus one when one string ends first within the limit, and returns zero when they match.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:Install F117A:0:0F74
name: append_string_with_limit
description: Appends a zero-terminated source string to the end of a destination string, copying no more than the given number of bytes, and terminates the result. It returns the destination pointer.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:Install F117A:0:0FCC
name: build_full_path_name
description: Builds a full path from a device name, a directory and a file name, adding a colon after the device and a path separator after the directory when they are missing. If an extension is given, it appends a dot and the extension.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:Install F117A:0:106C
name: lowercase_string_in_place
description: Converts each character of a zero-terminated string to lower case in place, using a per-character class table to decide which characters are upper-case letters. It returns the string pointer.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:Install F117A:0:10A8
name: calculate_string_length
description: Returns the number of bytes before the terminating zero byte of a string.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:Install F117A:0:10BC
name: copy_null_terminated_string
description: Copies bytes from a source string into a destination until and including the zero terminator, then returns the destination pointer.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:Install F117A:0:10CC
name: compare_strings_ordering
description: Compares two zero-terminated strings character by character. It returns zero when they match, one when the first string differs and its character is greater, and minus one when it is smaller.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:Install F117A:0:10EC
name: append_string_to_end
description: Finds the terminator of the destination string and copies the source string, including its terminator, onto the end. It returns the destination pointer.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:Install F117A:0:1104
name: split_strings_into_pointer_table
description: Walks a buffer of zero-terminated strings and stores a pointer to each one in a table, up to a given count. It writes a null pointer after the last entry when the strings run out first and returns the number of entries, or minus one when the count is not positive or the table is already full.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:Install F117A:0:1154
name: copy_string_return_end
description: Copies a zero-terminated source string into the destination, including the terminator. It returns a pointer to the terminating byte in the destination.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:Install F117A:0:1174
name: find_first_char_in_set
description: Scans a string and returns a pointer to the first byte that also appears in a second zero-terminated set of characters. It returns a null pointer when no byte of the string is in the set.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:Install F117A:0:11B0
name: forward_both_args_unchanged
description: Passes both of its arguments straight through to another routine and returns nothing. It does no work of its own.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:Install F117A:0:11CC
name: read_digits_reverse_into_string
description: Collects one digit character per step from a source routine until it reports completion, stores the digits in a temporary buffer, then copies them into the destination in reverse order and terminates the string. It returns the length of the digit string.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:Install F117A:0:11FC
name: match_wildcard_pattern
description: Matches a text string against a pattern in which a question mark matches any single character and an asterisk matches any run of characters. It returns the number of text bytes matched, or zero when the pattern does not match.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:Install F117A:0:1264
name: convert_number_to_octal_string
description: Converts an unsigned number to octal digits, taking three bits at a time, and writes the digits in normal order followed by a terminating zero. It returns the number of digits written.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:Install F117A:0:12A4
name: convert_number_to_hex_digits
description: Converts an unsigned number to hexadecimal digits using a lookup table of digit characters, taking four bits at a time. It writes the digits in normal order followed by a terminating zero and returns the digit count.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:Install F117A:0:12D0
name: copy_file_name_from_path
description: Clears the destination, then copies the file name part of a path, the text after the last slash or colon, into it. The copy is capped at a fixed length and the copied length is returned.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:Install F117A:0:1330
name: parse_signed_decimal
description: Reads an optional sign and then decimal digits from the start of a string, stores the resulting number through a pointer, and returns the count of characters consumed. Digits are accumulated until a non-digit is reached.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:Install F117A:0:137C
name: append_byte_to_buffer
description: Stores one byte at the current write position of an output buffer, advances that position, and increments the count of bytes written.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:Install F117A:0:1396
name: format_into_buffer_counted
description: Resets a byte counter and points the output at the given buffer, then runs a formatting routine that sends each produced byte through the append-byte routine. It terminates the buffer with a zero and returns the number of bytes written.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:Install F117A:0:13D0
name: return_block_to_free_list
description: Returns a memory block of the given size to a sorted free list, rounding the size up to a multiple of four with a minimum of eight bytes. It merges the block with neighbouring free blocks and returns zero, or minus one when the block overlaps a block that is already free.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:Install F117A:0:14C8
name: delete_file_store_error_code
description: Calls a file-deletion step and, when that step reports failure, saves the system error code and sets a status value to two, returning minus one. When the step succeeds it returns zero.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:Install F117A:0:14F0
name: return_constant_zero
description: Returns zero without any other work.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:Install F117A:0:14F8
name: forward_to_entry_if_found
description: Looks up an entry from a handle and returns minus one if it is missing. Otherwise it forwards the call with the entry's pointer and the other arguments, and returns minus one when a status field is set.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:Install F117A:0:1540
name: write_status_line_if_set
description: When a saved state value is nonzero, it looks up the entry for that state and writes a line feed, the given text, a second text, the entry's text and another line feed through a write routine. It then returns the saved state value.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:Install F117A:0:1576
name: write_status_line_and_clear
description: Writes a line feed, a fixed text, the text of a looked-up entry and another line feed through a write routine. It then stores the value held in a register as the saved state.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:Install F117A:0:18BC
name: open_file_into_free_slot
description: Finds a free entry in a table of file slots, searching from the fourth entry onward, and opens the named file in a mode chosen from the requested flags. On success it stores the handle and position in the slot; it returns minus one with a stored error code when no slot is free, the flags are invalid, or the open fails.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:Install F117A:0:1A40
name: copy_memory_handling_overlap
description: Copies a block of bytes of the given length from one address to another. When the source starts at or before the destination it copies from the end backwards so overlapping bytes are not corrupted; otherwise it copies forwards.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:Install F117A:0:1A68
name: create_directory_unlock_on_success
description: Creates a directory, and on failure saves the system error code and returns minus one. When creation succeeds it releases the lock obtained for the directory and returns zero.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:Install F117A:0:1AA4
name: free_all_list_nodes
description: Walks a linked list of allocated nodes, releasing each node through a memory-free routine, then clears the list head and tail pointers. It returns zero.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:Install F117A:0:1AD4
name: release_pending_then_allocate
description: Releases the block saved in a pending slot, if any, and then, when a nonzero size is given, allocates a block of that size plus a header word. It stores the allocation size in the first word and returns the address just past it, or zero when no size was given or the allocation failed.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:Install F117A:0:1B20
name: forward_to_entry_if_found
description: Looks up an entry from a handle and returns minus one if it is missing. Otherwise it forwards the call with the entry's pointer and the other arguments, and returns minus one when a status field is set.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:Install F117A:0:1B68
name: allocate_and_link_list_node
description: Allocates a node large enough for the requested payload plus a twelve-byte header, appends it to the tail of a list, and returns a pointer to the payload just past the header. It returns a null pointer when the allocation fails.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:Install F117A:0:1F8C

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:Install F117A:0:2020
